scenario.action: real engine playthrough: cast from hand -> resolve -> graveyard
scenario.result: Auron's Inspiration is cast from hand and resolves for real ({2}{W} paid), then goes to the graveyard; its own +2/+0-to-attackers effect is an intentional no-op in this model (no attacking-creature state tracked).

scenario.action: real engine playthrough: Flashback cast from graveyard -> resolve -> exile
scenario.result: Auron's Inspiration is cast from the graveyard via Flashback ({2}{W}{W} paid instead of {2}{W}) and resolves for real, then is exiled instead of returning to the graveyard (its own "Then exile it" clause); its own +2/+0-to-attackers effect is again an intentional no-op in this model.
